subject.title: fix: keep LINE group allowlists scoped [AI]

question: Should LINE now enforce a strict DM/group allowlist separation even though existing configurations relying on the shipped DM `allowFrom` fallback may stop receiving group messages?
rationale: The code change strengthens the documented authorization boundary, but accepting the fail-closed compatibility impact and choosing the required upgrade diagnostic are maintainer policy decisions.

options.title: Land with upgrade diagnostic
options.body: Remove the fallback, add a Doctor or startup warning for affected LINE configurations, and require live LINE proof before merge.

options.title: Accept documentation-only migration
options.body: Merge the strict boundary with only the documentation note and accept that affected operators may first discover the change through blocked group messages.

options.title: Preserve the fallback
options.body: Keep current compatibility and defer strict separation until a separately designed migration or explicit policy surface is available.

recommendation.title: Land with upgrade diagnostic
recommendation.body: Remove the fallback, add a Doctor or startup warning for affected LINE configurations, and require live LINE proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available recent contributor connected to LINE webhook behavior, though explicit channel-owner history was not established.
